patterns.note: Sections frequently employ asymmetrical layouts with diagonal content breaks or overlapping elements, creating dynamic visual interest rather than simple horizontal divisions.
The hero section features exceptionally oversized, bold sans-serif typography that acts as a dominant visual element, interacting with the background imagery.
A sophisticated, earthy color palette is used, with muted pastels (peach, light blue, pale yellow, beige) serving as background blocks to segment content, often with a subtle gradient or texture.
The hero section features a dramatic scroll-triggered animation where the large 'ARENSBAK' text scales up and moves, while the background image parallaxes, creating a sense of depth and transition.
Product showcases are presented in distinct, full-width cards with unique background colors and clear calls to action, emphasizing individual product identities.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video background with a large, semi-transparent text overlay. As the user scrolls, the text scales up dramatically and moves vertically, while the background video parallaxes at a different rate, creating a dynamic reveal effect for the content below.
The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay on the hero to a sticky, solid-colored bar with a subtle shadow once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Hero headings are extremely oversized (~6x body) and bold, creating a strong visual impact, while body text is clean and highly legible with a balanced weight.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across most elements and content blocks, with only very subtle rounding on interactive elements like the cookie banner.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; sections are generously padded vertically, and content within blocks maintains a comfortable, open rhythm, contributing to a premium feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, interactive hero typography that scales and parallaxes with scroll, creating an immediate and memorable visual experience. This, combined with dynamic, asymmetrical section layouts featuring diagonal cuts and a sophisticated, earthy color palette, elevates it beyond a standard marketing template.
